description: A DDF window / as-of (point-in-time) aggregation over a numeric DataFrame (ARC-12, #384; part of the native distributed accelerated compute pass for UC-1 churn — #264). The leakage-free featurization primitive: for each entity, reduce the values of only the rows whose timestamp falls inside the time window — at or before `as_of`, and (when set) at or after `window_start` — so a feature computed as of t0 never sees a future event. Mirrored by zetta::ddf::AsOfAggregate in include/zetta/ddf/as_of.hpp and enforced by AsOfAggregate::from_json() in src/core/ddf/as_of.cpp — keep them in sync.

as_of.description: The upper cutoff (inclusive): a row qualifies iff its timestamp is <= as_of. The point-in-time at which the feature is computed.

entity_column.description: The integer-dtype column whose value groups rows into entities (the exact group key).

op.description: How qualifying values combine into the per-entity aggregate.

time_column.description: The numeric column carrying each row's timestamp (e.g. epoch seconds, or any monotonic encoding of time).

value_column.description: The numeric column reduced per entity over the window.

window_start.description: Optional lower cutoff (inclusive): a row also qualifies iff its timestamp is >= window_start, giving a trailing window [window_start, as_of]. Omitted for the unbounded-below (-inf, as_of] point-in-time case. Must not exceed as_of (that would be an empty window).

title: AsOfAggregate
